name: Noodles with Hamburg
description: A hearty casserole featuring ground hamburger, macaroni, and a blend of vegetables and cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: In a frying pan, brown the hamburger with celery and onions (if using). Drain excess fat.
Add garlic powder, oregano, salt, tomato soup, corn, and canned tomatoes to the browned hamburger mixture. Stir to combine.
Simmer the mixture slowly for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Cook macaroni according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
Combine the cooked macaroni with the hamburger and sauce mixture. Stir well.
If using cheese, heat it until melted and mix into the noodle and hamburger mixture.
Serve hot.

keywords: hamburger casserole, noodle dish, comfort food

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the macaroni, drain and set aside.
Brown hamburger, adding onions, green pepper and mushrooms.
Add the spices, ketchup and tomatoes. Reduce heat and simmer.
Place the macaroni and meat mixture in a large casserole dish and mix.
Spoon the mushroom soup across the top, covering the casserole.
Sprinkle the cheese on top.
Cover and bake in 350°F oven for ½ hour.

_similar.name: Baked Spaghetti and Meatballs
_similar.description: A hearty baked pasta dish featuring meatballs, spaghetti, and a rich tomato-based sauce topped with melted mozzarella cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F and start boiling water for cooking spaghetti.
In a large bowl, mix ground beef, chopped onion, egg, Worcestershire sauce, and black pepper. Form into meatballs.
Fry the meatballs in a skillet until completely cooked, turning gently with tongs. Drain off excess fat.
Add spaghetti sauce, diced tomatoes, mushrooms, green pepper, and oregano to the skillet. Simmer for approximately 15 minutes.
Cook spaghetti until 'al dente', then rinse and drain.
Combine cooked spaghetti with sour cream.
Pour the spaghetti mixture into a greased 6-cup casserole dish. Sprinkle with half of the shredded mozzarella cheese.
Cover with the sauce and meatball mixture. Bake, uncovered, at 350°F for approximately 20 minutes.
Top with remaining cheese and bake for an additional 5 to 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted.
